method: Node VM executes unchanged routing/render function source from the frozen HTML, with minimal JSON and location fixtures. No browser used; event, DOM, visual, scrolling, accessibility, reload/new-tab behavior remains unverified.

Legacy case ID redirects into explicit typed URL
Ambiguous old section URL does not silently select the first case
Unknown explicit case stays unknown instead of substituting another case
MED-C07 relation -> exact claim -> claim-specific locator retains return context
Precision/navigation comparison permits another case and return to the comparison
Chronology route gives linked bounded cases with both period and episode interval
